modelName: FLAIR-HUB land-cover from aerial imagery models
inputSpecification:
Trained on : 
-  R-G-B or NIR-R-G aerial images with 20 cm spatial resolution;
-  512x512 pixels (102.4x102.4m) patches. 

Inference allows large-scale images (chunking+overlap).
outputSpecification: Logits or argmax on a 15 classes nomenclature.
moreInformation:
Project page : https://ignf.github.io/FLAIR/ 
Publication : https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0924271626001899
Associated code : https://github.com/IGNF/FLAIR-HUB/
